title: CrestApps attempt policies configuration
description: Overrides of the attempt policies that count payments, declined cards, wrong codes and lookups (IAttemptLimiter), read from appsettings.json in the OrchardCore section of the host or a tenant. Each policy is named; see the Rate limits and card-testing protection page of the docs for the list and defaults.

AttemptPolicies.description: One entry per policy name, such as payment-decline-network, payment-begin-checkout or coupon-code. Only the values given change.

PermitLimit.description: How many attempts a key may have in a window. 0 turns the policy off.

Window.description: The window, as a time span such as 00:10:00.

BlockDuration.description: How long a key that reached the limit with failures stays blocked, as a time span such as 00:30:00. Empty or 00:00:00 for none.

ResetOnSuccess.description: Whether a success clears the key's counter.
